name: ensoniqplaywav16
description: ensoniqplay(1) M3 16-bit + decimation: a 16-bit signed WAV at 44100 Hz mono (0.5 s) exceeds the DOC's 26320 Hz ceiling, so the tool decimates by 2 to 22050 Hz and downconverts 16-bit signed to 8-bit unsigned.  22050 input frames / 2 = 11025 output samples, played placed.  'decimated 44100 -> 22050 Hz (/2)' proves the rate fit, 'wav 16-bit signed' proves the header path, and the ~30-tick halt proves the converted sample plays at the right rate.
